event_definition.start_state: The primary dog is visibly standing on all four weight-bearing legs facing the camera.
event_definition.ordered_transition: The primary dog bends both hind legs and continuously lowers its hips until the rear contacts the ground.
event_definition.terminal_state: The primary dog is stably seated while still facing the camera.
event_definition.actor_binding_rule: Only the designated primary dog may complete the sitting transition.
event_definition.object_binding_rule: No moved prop or secondary dog can substitute for the body transition.
event_definition.camera_background_rule: Camera and background remain stable enough to distinguish real hip lowering from viewpoint motion.

branch_descriptions.action: The primary dog bends both hind legs, lowers its hips to the ground, settles into a stable sit facing the camera, and holds the seated pose.
branch_descriptions.noop: The primary dog remains standing on all four legs with only breathing and tiny natural movements, never lowering its hips into a seated position.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The primary dog bends its hind legs and lowers partway but rises before its hips contact the ground, ending in a standing crouch.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The primary dog begins seated facing the camera, pushes upward through all four legs, reaches a stable stand, and holds the reversed terminal pose.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The primary dog lowers briefly, rises, turns sideways, and crouches in a scrambled order without completing and holding the camera-facing seated state.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The secondary background dog lowers into a stable sit while the primary dog remains standing on all four legs in the foreground throughout.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The primary dog remains standing and pushes the nearby toy with one paw, moving the distractor instead of lowering its own body to sit.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The primary dog remains frozen standing while only the camera lowers and moves forward, creating apparent vertical displacement without a real sitting action.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The primary dog's coat color changes gradually while its four-legged standing pose remains fixed, with no hind-leg bend or seated terminal state.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The primary dog walks in a small circle, shakes its head, and returns to standing without lowering its hips into a seated pose.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked wide camera shows a primary adult golden retriever standing squarely on all four legs in a bright white training studio, with a smaller secondary dog beside a distant bench and a blue rubber toy near the foreground.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: The full body remains visible continuously under stable lighting, with no cuts or viewpoint changes.

event_definition.start_state: The primary person is visibly kneeling or deeply crouched with hips low.
event_definition.ordered_transition: The primary person transfers weight onto both feet, raises the hips, and straightens the legs and torso in order.
event_definition.terminal_state: The primary person reaches a stable fully upright standing pose.
event_definition.actor_binding_rule: Only the designated primary person may complete the full rise to standing.
event_definition.object_binding_rule: Moving a nearby prop cannot substitute for raising the primary body.
event_definition.camera_background_rule: Camera height and background remain stable enough to verify genuine body elevation.

branch_descriptions.action: The primary person transfers weight onto both feet, rises smoothly from the low pose, straightens both legs and the torso, and holds a stable upright stand.
branch_descriptions.noop: The primary person remains in the original low kneeling or crouched pose with only natural breathing, never raising the hips into a stand.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The primary person raises the torso and hips only into a deep half-squat with bent knees, never reaching a fully straight upright stand.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The primary person begins standing upright, bends both knees, lowers the hips carefully into the registered low pose, and holds that reversed state.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The primary person rises halfway, lowers again, briefly straightens one leg, and ends crouched without the ordered transition to a stable upright stand.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The secondary background person rises fully to standing while the primary person remains low and unchanged in the foreground for the entire shot.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The primary person stays low and moves the nearby crate along the floor, manipulating the distractor without raising the body into a stand.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The primary person remains frozen low while only the camera rises and tilts downward, creating apparent upward motion without a real body transition.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The primary person's clothing changes color while the low body pose remains fixed, with no weight transfer, hip rise, or upright terminal state.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The primary person leans sideways, rotates while low, and reaches forward before returning to the initial pose without standing upright.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked full-body camera shows a primary older man kneeling on his right knee in a tidy wood workshop, with a secondary mechanic kneeling far behind him and a small red crate resting beside the primary man's left hand.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: Both feet and the entire torso stay visible under constant light in one continuous uncut shot.

event_definition.start_state: The primary person visibly holds both arms raised above shoulder level.
event_definition.ordered_transition: The primary person lowers both arms and places the left and right hands onto the corresponding hips.
event_definition.terminal_state: Both hands rest firmly on the primary person's hips in a stable pose.
event_definition.actor_binding_rule: Both moving arms and both terminal hands must belong to the primary person.
event_definition.object_binding_rule: Moving a bag or another object cannot substitute for lowering both arms.
event_definition.camera_background_rule: The camera and background remain locked so arm lowering is directly observable.

branch_descriptions.action: The primary person slowly lowers both raised arms, places both hands firmly on the hips, and holds the completed hands-on-hips pose with a locked camera.
branch_descriptions.noop: The primary person keeps both arms raised for the entire shot with only natural breathing, never placing either hand onto either hip.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The primary person lowers both arms only halfway and pauses with both hands suspended away from the hips, never completing the terminal pose.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The primary person begins with both hands on the hips, lifts both arms upward, and ends with both arms raised in the reversed state.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The primary person touches one hip, raises both arms again, lowers only one arm, and ends before both hands reach the registered terminal pose.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The secondary background person lowers both arms and places both hands on their hips while the primary person keeps both arms raised throughout.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The primary person keeps both arms raised and instead lifts and repositions the nearby handbag, leaving both hands away from the hips.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The primary person remains frozen with raised arms while only the camera cranes downward and sideways, producing screen motion without any arm action.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The primary person's clothing changes color while the raised-arm pose remains fixed, and neither hand moves toward either hip at any time.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The primary person turns in place, takes two side steps, and returns to center without lowering both arms into the hands-on-hips pose.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked medium full-body view shows a primary athletic man standing with both empty arms raised overhead in a quiet gym, while a secondary trainer stands near the rear wall and a black sports bag rests beside the primary subject.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: The framing includes both arms and hips continuously with stable illumination and no cuts.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked medium full-body view shows a primary older woman standing on a garden patio with both arms raised above her shoulders, while a secondary gardener waits near a distant table and a woven basket sits beside the primary subject.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: Her hands and hips remain inside the continuous frame under steady daylight without camera movement.

event_definition.start_state: The primary person's head is visibly angled away with a neutral closed mouth.
event_definition.ordered_transition: The primary person rotates the head into a frontal orientation and then forms a relaxed closed-mouth smile.
event_definition.terminal_state: The primary person faces forward with the relaxed smile clearly held.
event_definition.actor_binding_rule: The turning head and smiling face must both belong to the primary person.
event_definition.object_binding_rule: Movement of a scarf or nearby prop cannot substitute for the facial event.
event_definition.camera_background_rule: A locked camera must distinguish physical head rotation from viewpoint orbit.

branch_descriptions.action: The primary person smoothly turns the angled head to face forward, forms a relaxed closed-mouth smile, and holds the frontal smiling expression with a locked camera.
branch_descriptions.noop: The primary person keeps the head angled away with a neutral closed mouth, only blinking and breathing, never facing forward or forming the requested smile.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The primary person turns only partway toward the viewer but stops before a frontal pose and never completes the relaxed closed-mouth smile.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The primary person begins facing forward with a relaxed smile, loses the smile, turns the head away, and holds the reversed averted neutral pose.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The primary person smiles before turning, looks away again, briefly approaches a frontal angle, and ends without the ordered frontal smiling terminal state.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The secondary background person turns forward and smiles while the primary person remains angled away with a neutral expression throughout the shot.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The primary person keeps the head and mouth unchanged while adjusting the nearby scarf, never completing the requested head and facial transition.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The primary person remains frozen while only the camera orbits toward a frontal viewpoint, creating an apparent angle change without a real head turn or smile.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The primary person's hair color changes gradually while the head angle and neutral mouth remain fixed, with no forward turn and no new smile.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The primary person nods twice, looks downward, and raises both shoulders, never turning fully forward or settling into the relaxed smiling expression.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked close portrait shows a primary young man beside a library desk with his head angled away and mouth neutral, while a secondary reader sits softly focused in the background and a folded green scarf lies near the primary subject.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: Both facial orientation and mouth shape remain clearly visible in continuous stable light without cuts.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked close portrait shows a primary older woman at a quiet cafe table with her head angled away and lips neutral, while a secondary customer remains distant and a blue scarf rests beside the primary subject's elbow.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: The face stays unobstructed under steady warm illumination throughout one continuous stationary-camera shot.

event_definition.start_state: The primary person visibly holds a two-finger peace sign near shoulder height.
event_definition.ordered_transition: The primary person closes the peace sign, opens the full palm, and moves that palm side to side in a wave.
event_definition.terminal_state: The primary person holds the open palm after completing the visible wave.
event_definition.actor_binding_rule: The transforming and waving hand must belong to the designated primary person.
event_definition.object_binding_rule: A waving cloth or other prop cannot substitute for the hand gesture.
event_definition.camera_background_rule: The camera remains locked so hand articulation is separable from screen motion.

branch_descriptions.action: The primary person closes the peace sign, opens the full palm toward the viewer, performs a clear side-to-side wave, and holds the open palm.
branch_descriptions.noop: The primary person keeps the original two-finger peace sign unchanged with only natural breathing, never opening the whole palm or performing a wave.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The primary person relaxes the peace sign and opens the palm but stops before any side-to-side wave, ending with an unmoving open hand.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The primary person begins with an open waving palm, stops the wave, folds the fingers into a peace sign, and holds the reversed terminal gesture.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The primary person waves while retaining the peace sign, briefly opens the palm, closes it again, and ends without the ordered open-palm hold.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The secondary background person changes a peace sign into an open-palm wave while the primary person keeps the original peace sign unchanged.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The primary person keeps the peace sign fixed and instead waves the nearby small cloth, never producing the requested open-palm hand gesture.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The primary person keeps both hands frozen while only the camera pans side to side, producing screen motion without any finger transition or hand wave.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The primary person's sleeve changes color while the two-finger peace sign remains fixed, with no open palm and no side-to-side hand movement.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The primary person lowers the hand, claps twice, and folds both arms, never transforming the peace sign into the requested open-palm wave.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked medium portrait shows a primary young woman in an art studio holding a right-hand peace sign near her shoulder, while a secondary painter stands by the rear wall and a small red cloth lies on the foreground table.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: Her fingers and open palm stay fully visible under constant illumination in one continuous shot.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked medium portrait shows a primary older man in a bright kitchen holding a left-hand peace sign near his shoulder, while a secondary cook waits in the distant background and a small white towel rests beside the primary subject.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: The raised hand remains unobstructed and sharply framed throughout the continuous stationary-camera sequence.

event_definition.start_state: The primary person visibly holds the left hand as a fist near the torso.
event_definition.ordered_transition: The primary person opens the left fist, extends the left arm forward, and rotates the open palm downward.
event_definition.terminal_state: The left arm is fully forward with an open palm-down hand held steadily.
event_definition.actor_binding_rule: The extending left arm must belong to the designated primary person.
event_definition.object_binding_rule: The right arm or a moved prop cannot substitute for the left-arm event.
event_definition.camera_background_rule: The camera remains locked so real arm extension is separable from perspective change.

branch_descriptions.action: The primary person relaxes the left fist, extends the left arm forward, rotates the open hand palm-down, and holds the completed forward-reaching pose.
branch_descriptions.noop: The primary person keeps the left fist and original arm position unchanged with only natural breathing, never extending an open palm forward.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The primary person opens the left fist and begins extending the arm but stops near the torso before reaching forward or rotating palm-down.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The primary person begins with the left arm extended palm-down, retracts the arm toward the torso, closes the hand into a fist, and holds it.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The primary person extends a clenched fist, retracts it, briefly opens the hand, and ends near the torso without the ordered palm-down forward hold.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The secondary background person opens a left fist and extends an open palm-down hand while the primary person keeps the original fist pose unchanged.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The primary person leaves the left fist unchanged and instead extends the right arm palm-down, moving the wrong limb for the target event.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The primary person remains frozen while only the camera pushes forward and slides left, creating apparent arm displacement without real fist opening or extension.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The primary person's left sleeve changes texture while the clenched fist and arm position stay fixed, with no forward open-palm movement.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The primary person raises both shoulders, turns the torso, and steps backward without opening the left fist or extending the requested arm.

topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: The complete left arm and both hands remain visible continuously under stable neutral lighting.

topup_identity_scenes.scene_caption: A locked waist-up view shows a primary older man in an art gallery holding his left fist close to his chest, while a secondary visitor stands far behind him and a slim catalog rests beside his right hand.
topup_identity_scenes.camera_caption: His left shoulder, elbow, wrist, and palm stay inside one continuous evenly lit frame.
